prompt: At the grocery co-op, the display price applies only to a full basket. Individual pears are priced by weight, so a shopper taking just two pears should ____.
promptZh: 合作社的展示價格只適用於整籃購買。單買梨子按重量計價，因此只拿兩顆梨子的顧客應 ____。

options.text: pay the displayed price for one full basket
options.zh: 支付一整籃的展示價格
options.whyZh: 顧客只拿兩顆，不能套用整籃售價。

options.text: use the displayed price for each pear
options.zh: 把展示價格當成每顆梨子的售價
options.whyZh: 展示價格是整籃價，不是單顆定價。

options.text: divide the basket price by the number of pears it holds
options.zh: 以每籃梨子的顆數平分整籃價格
options.whyZh: 散裝梨子按重量，不是把籃裝價格按顆數攤分。

options.text: have the two pears weighed to determine the price
options.zh: 把那兩顆梨子秤重後計價
options.whyZh: 買的是兩顆散裝梨子，要按實際重量計價，無法套用整籃售價。

explanationZh: 買的是兩顆散裝梨子，要按實際重量計價，無法套用整籃售價。
evidence: At the grocery co-op, the display price applies only to a full basket. Individual pears are priced by weight, so a shopper taking just two pears should have the two pears weighed to determine the price.

vocabulary.note: 以商品重量決定應付金額。
